void traverse(long long valA, long long valB, int idxA, int idxB) {
    long long diff = llabs(valA - valB);
    if (minDiff <= 1 || diff - comb[idxA][rows] * comb[idxB][rows] >= minDiff)

            bestValue = valA;
        }
        return;

    if (idxA >= rows) {
        long long addA = comb[idxA][rows] - comb[idxA - 1][rows];
        long long sumB = comb[idxB][rows];
        traverse(valA, valB + addA * sumB, idxA - 1, idxB);

    if (idxB >= rows) {
        long long sumA = comb[idxA][rows];
        long long addB = comb[idxB][rows] - comb[idxB - 1][rows];
        traverse(valA + sumA * addB, valB, idxA, idxB - 1);
    }
}

unordered_map<long long, long long> memo;

    long long state = valA * 1000000 + idxA * 1000 + idxB;

    long long diff = llabs(valA - valB);

            int newIdxB = idxB - prefixB[totalSteps];

        return ans = 0;

        long long sumB = comb[idxB][rows];
        ans += countPaths(valA, valB + addA * sumB, idxA - 1, idxB);

    if (ch != 'A') {
        long long sumA = comb[idxA][rows];
        long long addB = comb[idxB][rows] - comb[idxB - 1][rows];
